outgoing.name: Ancient Greece
outgoing.excerpt: The first elaborate theatrical stages are found in Ancient Greece where stages were originally threshing floors which developed into large, open-air ampitheaters with permanent stages.

outgoing.excerpt: These same theatre layouts were adopted by the Romans who spread them across Europe.
